description: This file defines an abstract class 'AssetControllerBase' in Drupal, responsible for serving asset aggregates such as CSS or JS files. It includes methods for delivering assets, validating requests, and managing asset groups, with dependencies on various Drupal core and Symfony components.

classes.name: AssetControllerBase
classes.description: An abstract controller class in Drupal for serving asset aggregates, handling request validation, asset group management, and response generation.

methods.name: deliver
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests to deliver asset files, validating parameters, checking for existing files, generating asset groups, and returning appropriate responses.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Retrieves a specific asset group based on the provided group delta, throwing an exception if invalid.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses to retrieve grouped assets based on attached assets and request.
